use std::env;
use std::{env as process, env::{var as read, var_os, vars}};
fn run() {
    // Each read is a candidate path switch. The fixture does not execute.
    std::env::var("MODE");
    std::env::var_os("MODE");
    std::env::vars();
    std::env::vars_os();
    env::var("MODE");
    process::var_os("MODE");
    read("MODE");
    var_os("MODE");
    vars();
    let reader = std::env::var::<&str>;
    ::std::env::var_os("MODE");
}
